name: svg-badge-outline
description: CS30075 Lab1 Phase 2, part 1: a [] badge on .svg files and an outline of the SVG element tree

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --target node --format cjs --external vscode --outfile dist/extension.js
scripts.build:integration: bun build integration/Badge.itest.ts integration/Outline.itest.ts --target node --format cjs --external vscode --outdir out/integration
scripts.test:integration: bun run build && bun run build:integration && vscode-test
